brand.description: A private, non-custodial wallet that lives only in your browser.

onboarding.welcomeDescription: Create a new wallet or bring back an existing one. Your recovery phrase is encrypted on this device and never sent anywhere.
onboarding.importDescription: Restore access with your existing 12 words.
onboarding.securityNote: Non-custodial by design. Lilixy can never access your funds or recovery phrase.
onboarding.createStepDescription: These 12 words are the only way to recover your wallet. Store them offline, in the exact order shown.
onboarding.mnemonicWarning: Never share these words. Anyone who has them can take your funds.
onboarding.mnemonicScreenshot: Do not take a screenshot. Screenshots can sync to cloud storage or be read by other apps.
onboarding.writtenDown: I have written down all 12 words
onboarding.verifyDescription: Enter the missing words to prove you saved your phrase correctly.
onboarding.verificationFailed: Those words do not match. Check your backup and try again.
onboarding.importStepDescription: Enter your 12-word recovery phrase in the correct order.
onboarding.importPlaceholder: Enter your 12 words separated by spaces
onboarding.pasteHint: You can paste the whole phrase at once.
onboarding.invalidMnemonic: This is not a valid 12-word BIP39 recovery phrase.
onboarding.checksumError: The words are valid, but the checksum does not match. Check the order and spelling.
onboarding.passwordDescription: Choose a strong password. It encrypts your recovery phrase on this device and is never stored.
onboarding.passwordWeak: Choose a stronger password that meets all requirements.

password.reqVariety: At least 3 of: lowercase, uppercase, numbers, symbols

lock.title: Welcome back
lock.subtitle: Enter your password to unlock Lilixy Wallet.
lock.forgotDescription: A non-custodial wallet cannot recover your password. You can reset this device and restore with your recovery phrase.
lock.securityNote: Your recovery phrase is decrypted only in memory while the wallet is unlocked.

wallet.noAssetsDescription: Receive a token or add a custom token to see it here.
wallet.noResultsDescription: Try a different search or network filter.
wallet.connectError: Wallet connection could not be restored. Lock and unlock to try again.
wallet.pageDescription: Manage your assets, networks, and tokens.

send.title: Send crypto
send.description: Send tokens on the selected network. Always verify the address and network.
send.sentDescription: Your transaction was broadcast to the network.
send.failedDescription: The wallet could not send this transaction.
send.insufficientGas: Not enough native balance to cover the network fee.
send.sameAddress: You cannot send to your own address.
send.gasUnavailable: Fee estimate unavailable. Check your RPC connection and try again.
send.confirmationDescription: This action will be signed locally on your device.
send.erc20Warning: Token transfers use the ERC-20 contract on {{network}}.
send.gasInsufficient: Insufficient balance for the network fee.
send.gasInsufficientToken: Not enough {{symbol}} for the network fee.
send.tokenPickerHint: Zero balances are hidden by default.

receive.title: Receive crypto
receive.description: Share this address to receive assets on {{network}}.
receive.warning: Only send assets on {{network}} to this address. Assets sent on another network may be lost.
receive.qrLabel: QR code for your wallet address

swap.title: Swap & Bridge
swap.description: Swap tokens or move assets across chains with LI.FI.
swap.widgetError: The swap widget could not be loaded.
swap.widgetErrorDescription: Check your connection and try again. Your wallet stays locked and safe.
swap.connectingDescription: Connecting your local wallet to the swap provider.
swap.feeNote: A {{fee}} integrator fee supports Lilixy on eligible routes.
swap.disclaimer: Routes are provided by LI.FI. Review fees and slippage before confirming.

history.title: Transaction history
history.description: Your activity across every network, in one place.
history.emptyDescription: Transactions you make in Lilixy will appear here.
history.localOnlyNotice: History is stored only on this device. Clearing browser data removes it permanently.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your wallet, preferences and security.
settings.autoLockDescription: Lock the wallet after a period of inactivity.
settings.changePasswordDescription: Re-encrypt your recovery phrase with a new password.
settings.showRecoveryDescription: Reveal your 12 words after confirming your password.
settings.networksDescription: Add and manage custom EVM networks.
settings.tokensDescription: Add custom ERC-20 tokens to your portfolio.
settings.pendingDescription: Review, replace or clear stuck transactions.
settings.resetDescription: Erase this wallet, history and settings from this device.
settings.lockNowDescription: Immediately clear the unlocked wallet from memory.
settings.privacy: No analytics. No tracking. No custody.
settings.appearanceDescription: Choose how Lilixy looks on this device.
settings.fiatNote: Balances are converted using CoinGecko reference prices.
settings.localHistoryDescription: Transaction records saved on this device only.
settings.clearLocalHistoryDescription: Delete all locally stored transaction records.
settings.clearLocalHistoryConfirm: This permanently deletes all transaction records from this browser. On-chain transactions are not affected.
settings.contactDescription: Reach the Lilixy team on your preferred channel.
settings.fontSizeDescription: Adjust text size across the app.

networks.title: Network management
networks.description: Built-in networks and your custom EVM chains.
networks.name: Network name
networks.deleteDescription: Custom tokens and local history for {{network}} will also be removed. On-chain funds are not affected.
networks.noCustomDescription: Add an EVM network to use it in Lilixy.
networks.invalidRpc: Enter a valid HTTP(S) RPC URL.
networks.invalidExplorer: Enter a valid HTTP(S) explorer URL.
networks.mismatch: The RPC reported chain ID {{actual}}, not {{expected}}.
networks.duplicate: A network with this chain ID already exists.
networks.rpcError: Could not connect to this RPC.
networks.invalidChainId: Chain ID must be a positive whole number.
networks.chainIdLocked: Chain ID cannot be changed after creation.

tokens.title: Token management
tokens.description: Add custom ERC-20 tokens by contract address.
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.label: Display name
tokens.deleteDescription: The token will disappear from your portfolio. On-chain funds are not affected.
tokens.noCustomDescription: Add an ERC-20 contract to track it here.
tokens.invalidContract: Enter a valid ERC-20 contract address.
tokens.invalidToken: This address does not look like a valid ERC-20 token.
tokens.alreadyAdded: This token is already tracked on this network.
tokens.readError: Could not read token metadata from the contract.
tokens.cannotEditMetadata: Contract metadata is read-only. You can change the display name.
tokens.unverified: This token is unverified. Anyone can create a token with any name or symbol. Verify the contract before trading.

pending.title: Pending transactions
pending.description: Transactions that have not confirmed yet.
pending.emptyDescription: Everything is confirmed. New broadcasts will appear here.
pending.clearDescription: This only removes local records. It does not cancel transactions on-chain. Use Cancel to replace a transaction.
pending.cannotReplace: This transaction cannot be replaced because its original nonce or fee data is missing.
pending.replacementFailed: Could not send the replacement transaction.
pending.cancelDescription: Sends a 0-value transaction to your own address with the same nonce and a higher fee.
pending.speedUpDescription: Re-sends the same transaction with the same nonce and a higher fee.
pending.confirmReplacementDescription: A new transaction with nonce {{nonce}} will be broadcast. Only confirm if the original is still pending.

changePassword.title: Change wallet password
changePassword.description: Your recovery phrase will be decrypted, re-encrypted with the new password and stored again.
changePassword.successDescription: Your recovery phrase is now protected with the new password.

recovery.title: Recovery phrase
recovery.description: Confirm your password to reveal the 12 words.
recovery.screenshotWarning: Do not screenshot or share this phrase. Anyone who sees it can access your funds.

reset.title: Reset Lilixy Wallet
reset.description: This permanently removes the encrypted wallet, transaction history and settings from this browser. Funds remain on-chain and can only be restored with your recovery phrase.
reset.warning: Make sure you have your 12-word recovery phrase. This action cannot be undone.
reset.failed: Could not fully reset the wallet.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Network request failed. Check your connection and RPC settings.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait {{time}} before trying again.
errors.vaultCorrupted: The encrypted wallet is corrupted or unsupported.
errors.cryptoUnavailable: Web Crypto is unavailable. Use a modern secure browser.
errors.indexedDb: Browser storage is unavailable. Disable private mode or allow site data.
errors.noVault: No wallet was found on this device.
errors.weakPassword: Password does not meet the security requirements.
errors.bridgeStatus: Bridge status could not be fetched.

toast.phraseCopied: Recovery phrase copied — clear your clipboard after use

errorPage.title: Storage unavailable
errorPage.description: The page could not be rendered. Your wallet and keys remain on this device.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist inside Lilixy Wallet.

footer.madeWith: Built with care for your keys.

legal.title: Privacy & terms
legal.privacy: Lilixy does not collect analytics. Your keys stay on this device. Local history is stored only in this browser and is deleted when browser data is cleared.
legal.disclaimer: This software is provided as-is. You are responsible for your keys, addresses, networks and transactions. Use at your own risk.
legal.faq1: No. Reset this device and restore with your 12-word recovery phrase.
legal.faq2: Only on this device. Clearing browser data removes it permanently.
